snippet.title: [All Endings] Lights Out - Forgotten Past Psychological Horror
snippet.description:
*About this game
https://masefield.itch.io/lights-out

You are called to some apartments to fix a faulty light, but your forgotten past catches up with you...
Contains flashing lights, jump scares and disturbing scenes.
There are 4 different endings.

Move:  W A S D
Sprint:  Shift
Interact:  E / Left Mouse Button
Next Text:  Right Mouse Button
Pause/ Quit:  Escape

Author Masefield Games
